data: Apple's fiscal 2025, which ended in late September 2025, produced net sales of about $416.2 billion, cost of sales of about $221.0 billion, and gross profit of about $195.2 billion, for a gross margin of roughly 46.9%. Operating income was about $133.1 billion, an operating margin of roughly 32.0%. These figures are from my training data rather than a live filing, so please verify them against Apple's FY2025 Form 10-K before relying on them.
